b: Amazon has a whopping of a discount on the Leatherman Charge TTI multi-tool. As part of their Black Friday deals, save 50% while the deal or supplies last.
I’ll repeat what I said for the fleeting Prime Day deal last month (Leatherman Discounted this Multi-Tool by 50% for Prime Day 2026).
Should you buy it? The Charge Plus TTI is a premium upgrade to the Wave, which is Leatherman’s most popular multi-tool (also discounted for Black Friday, see below).
This tool is a great pick for EDC (everyday carry) and outdoors enthusiasts. It’s no substitute for a well-stocked tool box, but it does fit in your pocket or on your belt.
It seems that the Charge TTI has been discontinued, as the link to the Charge Plus TTI on Leatherman’s site now get automatically redirected to the Wave Alpha, which retails for $199.95.
The Charge TTI has a S30V blade steel, the Wave Alpha has MagnaCut (more premium). The TTI has decorated titanium handle scales, the Alpha has G10 (fiberglass epoxy composite).
Right now, the Wave is $104 (discounted for Black Friday), the Wave Alpha is $200, and the Charge TTI is $100.
If you’re on the fence, buy it first, think about it later, cancel before it ships.
